text.en:
Powered Heavy Attacks spawn clusters of 'Telesto Bolts', each dealing <pve 96 or 125 /> <pvp [83] /> damage. 

Telesto Bolt clusters vary by Sword Frame:
• Aggressive: 8 bolts in a clustered spread ahead of you
• Caster: 6 bolts on projectile point of impact
• Lightweight: 7 bolts in a forward arc ahead of you
• Vortex: 10 bolts spread around you
• Wave: 8 bolts at the end of the wave

Powered Heavy Attacks spawn clusters of 'Telesto Bolts', each dealing <pve 68 or 117 /> <pvp [83] /> damage. 

Telesto Bolt clusters vary by Sword Frame:
• Aggressive: 8 bolts in a clustered spread ahead of you
• Caster: 6 bolts on projectile point of impact
• Lightweight: 7 bolts in a forward arc ahead of you
• Vortex: 10 bolts spread around you
• Wave: 8 bolts at the end of the wave
